description: The IF EXISTS clause of ALTER TABLE: every action form (RENAME TO, ADD/DROP/RENAME COLUMN, SET COMMENT) is a clean no-op on a missing table (and creates nothing) while the unforgiven forms error; on an existing table each action applies normally - with qualified names, sequences of forgiven statements, and data-bearing tables untouched. Converted 1:1 from features/AlterTableIfExistsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE non_existent_table RENAME TO new_table
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS non_existent_table RENAME TO new_table
ALTER TABLE non_existent_table ADD COLUMN new_col VARCHAR
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS non_existent_table ADD COLUMN new_col VARCHAR
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS non_existent_table DROP COLUMN old_col
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS non_existent_table RENAME COLUMN old_col TO new_col
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS non_existent_table SET COMMENT = 'Some comment'
CREATE TABLE existing_table (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS existing_table ADD COLUMN age INTEGER
DESCRIBE TABLE existing_table
SELECT COUNT_IF("name" = 'AGE') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE old_name (id INTEGER)
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS old_name RENAME TO new_name
SHOW TABLES LIKE 'old_name'
SHOW TABLES LIKE 'new_name'
CREATE TABLE test_table (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, age INTEGER)
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS test_table DROP COLUMN age
DESCRIBE TABLE test_table
CREATE TABLE test_table (id INTEGER, old_name VARCHAR)
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS test_table RENAME COLUMN old_name TO new_name
DESCRIBE TABLE test_table
SELECT COUNT_IF("name" = 'NEW_NAME') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE test_table (id INTEGER)
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS test_table SET COMMENT = 'Test comment'
SHOW TABLES LIKE 'test_table'
SELECT MAX(IFF("name" = 'TEST_TABLE', "comment", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE SCHEMA alter_ie_schema
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS alter_ie_schema.non_existent RENAME TO new_table
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS table1 ADD COLUMN col1 VARCHAR
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS table2 DROP COLUMN col2
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS table3 RENAME TO table4
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS table5 RENAME COLUMN old TO new
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS table6 SET COMMENT = 'Comment'
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS phantom_table ADD COLUMN col1 VARCHAR
SHOW TABLES LIKE 'phantom_table'
CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1, 'Alice')
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (2, 'Bob')
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS customers ADD COLUMN email VARCHAR
SELECT * FROM customers
DESCRIBE TABLE customers
